[Questions, comments, and reports about any tool on this site.]{.lead-line}

## Discussion forum

The discussion forum for all MATRIX software is hosted on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/software/discussions). Post questions about the use of a method in the [Q&A](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/software/discussions/categories/q-a) category, with the name of the method in the title. A GitHub account is required to post.

## Bug reports

Report a reproducible error in the repository of the corresponding package.

| Software | Issue tracker |
|---|---|
| ANCOMBC (R): ANCOM-BC, ANCOM-BC2, SECOM | [MATRIX-Research-Lab/ANCOMBC](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/ANCOMBC/issues) |
| scikit-bio (Python): ANCOM-BC, ANCOM-BC2 | [scikit-bio/scikit-bio](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/issues) |
| q2-composition (QIIME 2) | [QIIME 2 Forum](https://forum.qiime2.org/) |
| MetVAE (R) | [MATRIX-Research-Lab/MetVAE](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/MetVAE/issues) |
| MetVAE (Python) | [MATRIX-Research-Lab/MetVAE-PyPI](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/MetVAE-PyPI/issues) |
| MetVAE (GNPS) | [Some-Earth-2514/GNPS_Local](https://github.com/Some-Earth-2514/GNPS_Local/issues) |
| TriGer (R) | [MATRIX-Research-Lab/TriGer](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/TriGer/issues) |
| TriGer (Python) | [MATRIX-Research-Lab/TriGer-PyPI](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/TriGer-PyPI/issues) |
| TriGer (MATLAB) | [jy2941/TriGer](https://github.com/jy2941/TriGer/issues) |

- [Bioconductor Support](https://support.bioconductor.org/tag/ANCOMBC/) for questions about the ANCOMBC R package.
- [QIIME 2 Forum](https://forum.qiime2.org/) for questions about the QIIME 2 plugin.
